name: Game Boy Advance
description: Nintendo's 32-bit handheld, launched in 2001 as the successor to the Game Boy Color. Its ARM processor and colour screen gave it roughly Super Nintendo-class 2D graphics, and it played Game Boy and Game Boy Color cartridges. Later models fixed the original's unlit screen.

specs.graphics: 240 × 160 TFT LCD, 32,768 colours, tile and bitmap modes
specs.sound: 2 PCM channels plus the 4 Game Boy channels

curiosities: To run older Game Boy games it switches to a built-in Sharp SM83 core, the same type of processor as the original Game Boy.
The original model had no screen light; the 2003 Game Boy Advance SP added a frontlight and a built-in rechargeable battery.
The Game Boy Player attachment let the GameCube play Game Boy Advance cartridges on a TV.
The e-Reader accessory scanned dot-code strips printed on cards to unlock levels and mini-games.
